is_anopheles.evidence: The study evaluated 755 Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) mosquitoes (specifically An. coluzzii and An. gambiae s.s.) from southern Côte d'Ivoire (Page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study genotyped target site markers Vgsc-995F (L995F), Vgsc-995S (L995S), Vgsc-402L (V402L), Vgsc-1570Y (N1570Y), Ace1-280S (G280S), and the Ace1_AgDup CNV (Page 1, Abstract; Page 3-5).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Genotype counts broken down by species, phenotypic status (alive/dead), and collection locality are presented in Table 2 (Vgsc-995F and Vgsc-402L, n=168) and Table 3 (Ace1-280S, n=182) on pages 5-6.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquito larvae and pupae were collected from natural breeding sites in four rural localities in the department of Agboville, southern Côte d'Ivoire from September to October 2019 (Page 3, Section 2.1).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical field study involving mosquito sampling, WHO tube bioassays, and molecular genotyping.

sub_country_location.evidence: Collections were conducted at four specific sites in Agboville department with exact geographic coordinates: Boa Vincent (5°53'41.1"N, 4°35'32.136"E), Ango (5°51'50.364"N, 4°22'54.624"E), Gbalekro (5°56'57.408"N, 4°16'41.34"E), and Ouanguié (5°51'59.112"N, 4°13'42.888"E) (Page 3, Section 2.1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from September to October 2019 (Page 3, Section 2.1).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Primary field collections conducted independently in 2019 in Agboville, Côte d'Ivoire.

supplement.evidence: Main text tables (Tables 2 and 3) contain complete extractable genotype counts by phenotype and location for the primary target site markers.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated insecticide susceptibility and target-site / CNV resistance mechanisms in Anopheles gambiae (s.l.) collected from four rural sites in Agboville, Côte d'Ivoire in late 2019. Genotyping was performed for Vgsc (L995F, L995S, V402L, N1570Y), Ace-1 (G280S, Ace1_AgDup), and Cyp6aa/Cyp6p CNVs, with genotype frequencies linked to deltamethrin and pirimiphos-methyl bioassay outcomes.
